name: Tsukinoki Erika
source:
Likes: Spending time with [url=/c90362]Takumi[/url], cooking, rainy days, listening to music
Dislikes: Getting up early

Tohoku University, First year at Faculty of Economics. Originally from Hokuzumi Academy.

A sociable, popular, and lively person.

The girlfriend of her own childhood friend Takumi.
Her house is close to Takumi's, and has a good relationship with the family, even going out together several times. She's been always in love with Takumi and confessed her love a year before at the end of summer. Her first love and kiss were given to Takumi, and she's always dreaming of having a blessed marriage with him.

"I'm so happy. Having my first experiences on Takumi."
